person_note: The controlling voice is a nonparticipating third-person narrator, principally shifting focal attention among Marie-Laure, Werner, and other characters. Numerous event quotes independently show external thought attribution and sustained third-person scene narration, agreeing with the publisher excerpt and explicit whole-book POV descriptions. Alternating chapters and focal characters do not warrant ALTERNATING because the grammatical narrative person remains third throughout. Apparent first person in q03025 is dialogue, q03028 is Werner's embedded letter, and other I/we instances are speech, direct thought, or gnomic language. No credible evidence of sustained first- or second-person base sections was found.
